title: Order Lookup
description: The answer of the read-only order lookup to the Helpdesk Tool (UC-005). Trailhead Gear owns it. It allows no other field, so that no Customer name, email address or Shipping Address can get into it (UC-005 BR-004). It is built from the Order History, not converted from another message.

orderNumber.description: The Order Number that was looked up.

orders.description: Every Order received with this Order Number in the last 90 days, the most recent first (UC-005 A3). When none was received there is no Order Lookup (UC-005 A2).

partnerId.description: Partner that sent a Partner Order; only for the Channel `partner`.

receivedAt.description: When the Order was received, in UTC.

history.description: Every Order State the Order has passed through, the oldest first (UC-005 step 5).

at.description: When the Order reached it, in UTC.

rejectionReasons.description: Every Rejection Reason of a Rejected Order, in the order the Partner or the Order Desk received them (UC-005 A4).
